subject: Webinar: Developer Workshop — opt-in paths & 1P tracking
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar — opt-in paths & 1P tracking (developer workshop)

Hey team,

Quick kickoff for the developer workshop invite sequence next month. Two items we need to lock this week:

1) Opt-in pathways: we currently have three touch entry points (blog signup, product trial, partner co-reg). We need clear funnel mapping and a preferred first-email for each.
2) First-party tracking tokens: legal wants minimal PII in query params — we should design a 1P token that maps back to HubSpot but doesn't expose email.

I attached a basic UTM map (utm_map.csv) — please update with the tracking token column. Also attach any copy drafts you want us to test.

High priority: can we scope two CTA variants (CTA A: RSVP link with calendar add; CTA B: RSVP + code sample download)? I'd like to run a tiny A/B on click-to-RSVP.

Thanks — Ben

—
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar — opt-in paths & 1P tracking (developer workshop)

Ben — thanks for the start. A few quick thoughts:

- Segment mapping: recommend separate flows for
  * Product trial users (high-engagement: short cadence, immediate calendar invite)
  * Blog subscribers (nurture cadence: 3 touches over 10 days)
  * Partner co-reg (co-branded email, send from partner + from us)

- 1P token: propose a rotating token (hashed id + campaign id) that resolves server-side to contact id. Marissa — can you confirm if the CRM can accept that column for identification?

- Tracking links: we need unique hubspot link for each channel + variant. Ben, please produce the final utm_map.csv with campaign_id and token_col.

I've sketched two subject lines and short copy variants; attaching email_copy_v3.docx (light edits). Also think about a distinct EU consent line and an EU RSVP endpoint — legal flagged cookies/GDPR.

If we can lock this by Thursday, we can schedule the first batch the following Tuesday.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Events & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar — opt-in paths & 1P tracking (developer workshop)

All,

Uploading a quick mapping and rules doc inline below (also attached: 1p_tracking_spec.xlsx and updated utm_map.csv).

Rules summary:
- campaign_id: short handle (devworkshop_jul26)
- token_col: first_party_token (server-resolves to contact_id in HubSpot)
- channel links: blog, trial, partner_co_reg each get unique hs_link with campaign_id + variant param
- EU attendees: use /eu/rsvp path and consent checkbox; do NOT include token in querystring for EU — pass via short POST on submit

Action items:
- Ben: finalize CTA A/B copy and add CTA tags to utm_map.csv (due EOD Wed)
- Stephanie: confirm send windows per segment (morning PST for trial users; afternoons for blog subs)
- Me: I will generate the HubSpot landing pages and set up a Smart List for each opt-in path.

Attachments referenced: utm_map.csv, 1p_tracking_spec.xlsx

Thanks — Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alisha Kumar <alisha.k@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft invite + tracking approach — developer workshop co-host (for review)

Hi Alisha,

Great to sync last week — excited to co-host the developer workshop with Cumulus AI. Attached is a draft of the invite email plus our proposed opt-in path mapping and 1P tracking approach. High-level:

- We will send co-branded invites from both Redwood and Cumulus (partner co-reg path).
- Each channel (blog/trial/partner) will have a unique RSVP URL; links include campaign_id + variant but the PII token is resolved server-side so nothing identifiable is in the query string.
- For EU recipients we will use an /eu/rsvp landing and capture consent on page (no token in URL).

Draft RSVP link (testing): https://redwoodinference.com/rsvp?campaign=devworkshop_jul26&variant=A
HubSpot preview (internal): https://hubspot.com/contacts/12345
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B1DriveExample

Please review the copy (email_copy_v3.docx) and the tracking spec (1p_tracking_spec.xlsx). Would you prefer a single RSVP link for your list or a partner-specific sublink? For reporting we'd prefer partner-specific so we can attribute cleanly.

If this looks good, can your events team confirm partner link format by EOD Friday so Marissa can build the landing pages?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Events & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: email_copy_v3.docx (draft invite), 1p_tracking_spec.xlsx (tracking rules), utm_map.csv (utm mapping)
From: Alisha Kumar <alisha.k@cumulusai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: events@cumulusai.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft invite + tracking approach — developer workshop co-host (for review)

Thanks Stephanie — this looks solid. A few notes from partner ops: 

- Partner-specific link please (we'll append partner_id=cumulusai).
- For EU recipients we need explicit consent copy up front — we'll send suggested language (legal has that ready).
- Can you add a short preheader variant that mentions code samples? Our open rates jump 4–6% when code is in the preheader.

We'll confirm partner link format by EOD Monday. Once we have the link format Marissa, you can proceed with landing page scaffolds.

Appreciate the clear mapping — Alisha

—
Alisha Kumar
Head of Developer Relations, Cumulus AI
